title: Glenden Wood Dungeon
subtitle: Kill the Oversized Banderling Ogre and take its Platemail Hauberk
steps: In the Facility Hub, find the Warden for the Glenden Wood quest and take her portal to Glenden Wood, outside the dungeon.
Enter the dungeon and fight through to the Oversized Banderling Ogre at the far west end.
Kill it and take the Platemail Hauberk of the Ogre.
Bring the Hauberk back to the same Warden.

notes.title: Which ogre
notes.body: The Oversized Banderling Ogre is a single placed spawn at the far west end of the dungeon (20, -110, 6). The other six ogres are ordinary Banderling Ogres.

notes.title: Locked doors
notes.body: Prison cells and several doors need keys: keyglendendoor, keyglendenprison, keyglendenprison2 and the chest key. Creatures in the dungeon carry them, or pick the locks. The warden says to expect this.

notes.title: Best damage
notes.body: Ogres and Blades take 0.5 bludgeon, 0.65 pierce and acid, 0.76 slash and cold, and 1.08 fire and 1.32 electric. Use electric if you can.

notes.title: Getting in
notes.body: Hub portal needs level 10. The drop spot is outside near the dungeon, and the Surface portal inside leads back out.
